label: standard Ra (um) - trained on FLAT-surface data ONLY
package_file: ra_flat.onnx (renamed ra_flat_only.onnx here so the name says what it was trained on)
architecture: mil2d_multi (ImageNet ResNet-18 over 9 patches) + relative-error loss, 150 epochs, last epoch
training_data: 2026-11-11/12 flat tiles only (finishing 219 + roughing 199 = 418), all incl. former test split
preprocess_note: ra_predictor.spot_crop (= the v3 / v3-geo package predict.py, unchanged since 2026-11-10): 1100 px square centred on the laser spot found within 300 px of nominal_spot_xy, spot filled with the ring median, centre 900, grey copied to 3 channels, (x/255-0.5)/0.5
outputs: output = Ra [um], shape (N, 1); stage_logits = [finishing, roughing, nc] (nc not trained)
accuracy_note: same recipe trained without the test split, epoch 150; v3 split model on the same frames: flat 83.0, curved 86.0
use: for flat surfaces ONLY - the geometry is NOT judged from the image, the operator chooses the model (/arm/ra_model flat; robot_ui Task tab 'Ra model'); curved surfaces were not trained (use ra_curved_only). The default stays the v3 split model, which the package itself recommends.
